integrity: The exact source generator is reconstructed over GF(8). All 16807 normalized nonzero coordinate scalings are exhausted with exact finite-field Gram ranks; the source hull dimension and baseline weight distribution are independently checked.
scientific_limitations: The profile counts normalized diagonal scaling parameters and may include multiple parameters producing monomially equivalent copies. The invariant conclusion is only for the explicit \([6,3,3]_8\) code in Example 5.6, not for all codes with those parameters.
title: Complete monomial hull spectrum of the \([6,3,3]_8\) extension in Example 5.6
